title: Risk Register Row
description: Shape of a single row in docs/RISK_REGISTER.md. Enforced by scripts/validate-risk-register-schema.sh; illustrated by assets/templates/risk-register-row-template.yaml.

id.description: Permanent id, assigned once, never reused or renumbered.

description.description: Self-contained: what it is and why it exists, with no assumed prior context.

risk.description: One concrete sentence: the failure mode if this stays unaddressed, not a vague concern.

added.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date the row was created. Never changes.

status.description: Lifecycle state only. The resolution date and rationale live in the separate date/decision columns, not appended here.

date.description: "--" while status is Open; the resolution date (YYYY-MM-DD) once status flips to Resolved. Set together with decision, never independently.

decision.description: "--" while status is Open; a self-contained sentence on how it was resolved once status flips to Resolved. Set together with date, never independently.
